name: Stock
description: Last traded price for one share. US tickers are plain. NSE names need .NS, and the currency follows the listing.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Ticker in the path. AAPL or RELIANCE.NS.

params.name: amount
params.description: How many shares to extend the price across. Defaults to 1.

name: Market index
description: Index level for the S&P 500, Nasdaq, Nifty 50, or Sensex. /api/v1/index lists the four names.

params.name: name
params.description: sp500, nasdaq, nifty, or sensex, in the path.

name: Exchange rate
description: How much quote currency you get for one unit of the base. USDINR is rupees per dollar. /api/v1/fx lists a few common pairs.

params.name: pair
params.description: Pair in the path. USDINR, EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, or another 6 letter pair.

params.name: amount
params.description: How many units of the base currency to convert. Defaults to 1.

name: Crypto
description: Dollar price of bitcoin or ethereum. /api/v1/crypto lists the two coins.

params.name: symbol
params.description: btc or eth in the path. bitcoin and ethereum work too.

params.name: amount
params.description: How many coins to price. Fractions are fine. Defaults to 1.

name: Regret
description: What a pile of cash would be worth today if you had bought gold, bitcoin, oil, Nifty, Reliance, or the S&P on that date. Cash left alone is in the list too.

params.name: date
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD. A weekend walks forward to the next session.

params.name: amount
params.description: How much cash you pretend you had.

params.name: currency
params.description: INR or USD. Defaults to INR.

params.name: only
params.description: Comma list if you do not want the whole basket. gold, btc, oil, nifty, reliance, sp500.
